decisions.evidence: Overall, although the TPSA of 104.81 Å² and benzene count of 3 introduce some mitigating polarity, the combination of 4 alkyl aryl ethers, 14 rotatable bonds, 3 aromatic carbocycles, 3 benzene rings, and a strongly basic center with no acidic site makes hERG blockade the more likely outcome.
The overall nearest-neighbor pattern therefore supports option (B): blocks hERG.
